method: Fresh-context refutation of 32 records against cached source texts (tools.mjs text/grep/page); each quote, locator, date and figure checked against the passage and surrounding text; no re-fetch needed.

records.dateAndKind: right: event 2025-10-06, basis announcement; issue date unstated, as noted

records.fix: Qualification: 'A licence review policy, not a licence: it does not show any licence granted or any shipment. Case-by-case review applies to exports from the United States to end users located in China or Macau, for chips commercially available in the United States at publication and with the required certifications; reexports and in-country transfers to Macau or Country Group D:5, and exports to entities headquartered (or with a parent headquartered) in Macau or D:5 wherever located, remain under a presumption of denial.'
records.notes: Source text: 'For exports to entities that are headquartered or have a parent company headquartered in Macau or a destination in Country Group D:5, including end-users located outside of destinations in Country Group D:5 or Macau, the licensing policy is a presumption of denial.'
